correctness.rationale: The normalized projection body is the sum of centered cross-product segments. Both volumes are exact degree-six polynomials in nonnegative segment lengths. Saroglou’s proved five-generator equality kills all coefficients supported on at most five labels, leaving a nonnegative squarefree six-label sum. Its coefficient has ten complementary triple products versus fifteen perfect matchings. Rotational means E|det(U,V,W)|=pi/8 and E|U x V|=pi/4 give 20(pi/8)^2-15(pi/4)^3(pi/8)=5 pi^2(32-3 pi^2)/512. Separate radial degree-one homogeneity and independent first moments prove finite expectation. Exact integer six/seven-vector determinant checks and independent Monte Carlo normalization succeeded; these checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The exact expected nonnegative gap to the sharp zonoid projection-body bound is a natural finite-sample geometric invariant, not merely a recomputation of the classical extremal inequality. The positivity first appears as a six-body interaction; its evaluated universal constant and exact dependence only on mean radial lengths produce a meaningful cancellation/integrability result for heavy-tailed segment ensembles with infinite second moments.
